{scoring_rule_text} Determine the score of the single marked dart and use the matching option letter shown in the image.
Using the dartboard scoring rule, which visible option letter gives the score of the marked dart? {scoring_rule_text}

{ring_rule_text} What is the number of marked darts in the yellow-highlighted {target_ring_text}?

code_prompt_defaults.object_description_single_board: a labeled dartboard with visible dart markers
code_prompt_defaults.scoring_rule_text: A dart in a numbered single area scores that number; a dart in the double ring scores twice the number; a dart in the triple ring scores three times the number; the outer bull scores 25 and the inner bull scores 50.
code_prompt_defaults.ring_rule_text: The yellow highlight marks the requested scoring area. The double ring is the outer scoring band near the board edge. The triple ring is the inner scoring band between the bull and the outer edge. The bull is the center area. Single areas are the numbered wedge areas outside the bull that are not in the double or triple ring.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_total_score: set "annotation" to a JSON array with one pixel point [x, y] at the center of the marked dart
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_ring_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel points [x, y] at the center of every marked dart in the requested ring or area
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_threshold_score_count: set "annotation" to a JSON array of pixel points [x, y] at the center of every marked dart whose score is at least the requested threshold
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_total_score: set "answer" to the option letter shown in the image for the total score
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_ring_count: set "answer" to the number of marked darts in the requested ring or area; use 0 if none are in that area
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_threshold_score_count: set "answer" to the number of marked darts whose score is at least the requested threshold
